insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Opopop delivered $52,675 in total sales for Week 45, up 20.3% from $43,788 the prior week, on 2286 units. Organic revenue grew 30.0% to $35,896, led by the Gift Set at $11,208 (+169.2%) and the Super Butter 6-Pack at $8,726 (+18.8%). Friday, Nov 6 was the peak day at $8,610.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Flavor-Wrapped Popcorn Kit is gaining fast at $5,638 (+109.3%) with CVR up 47.1% to 7.7%, and we will keep building its momentum. The Variety 4-Pack Kit eased to $5,358 (-7.0%) with CVR at 9.6% (-8.8%), so we are watching it closely to bring it back to growth.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend came down to $4,417 from $5,243 while PPC revenue rose 3.7% to $16,779, lifting ROAS to 3.80x from 3.09x at a 26.3% ACOS. TACoS improved to 8.4% from 11.97%, with a healthy 14.75% ad conversion rate on a 0.59% ad CTR.

**Actions This Week —** We will shift budget toward the Gift Set, Super Butter 6-Pack and Flavor-Wrapped Popcorn Kit to build on their strong gains. We will also refine targeting on the Variety 4-Pack Kit and test new Sponsored Product and Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.59%.
